title: 1860. Inventory Reordering System

Inventory Reordering System
50
Medium
Topics
Inventory Reordering System
Problem Statement
Write a program to sort inventory items based on stock levels and identify critical items that need urgent attention.
An item is considered critical if its stock is less than 10 units.
Input Format
Line 1: Number of items (N)
Next N lines:
ItemName, Stock
Output Format
Display all items sorted in ascending order of stock, one per line in the format:
ItemName,Stock
Final line:
Comma-separated list of critical items (items with stock < 10), in the order they appear after sorting
Constraints
1 ≤ N ≤ 100
Item names contain no spaces
0 ≤ Stock ≤ 10,000
Sorting must be based on stock in ascending order
An item is critical if Stock < 10
Sample Input
5
Pen,50
Notebook,5
Marker,12
Charger,8
Mouse,10
Sample Output
Notebook,5
Charger,8
Mouse,10
Marker,12
Pen,50
Notebook,Charger
Explanation
1. Number of items = 5
2. Items and stock levels are read as input
3. Items are sorted in ascending order of stock:
   Notebook → 5
  Charger → 8
  Marker → 12
  Mouse → 10
  Pen → 50
4. Critical items are those with stock less than 10:
   Notebook (5)
   Charger (8)
5. Final output lists sorted items first, followed by the critical items in a comma-separated format.
